marc:datafield.marc:subfield: 大马文化年刊之2023《兔气扬眉》 | Dama wenhua niankan zhi 2023 (tu qi yang mei)

the 12th annual cultural magazine and the most expensive series ever to travel abroad to photograph cultural heritage, with 168 articles on 8 countries and over 1,000 beautifully photographed illustrations, including 23 articles on cultural and artistic journeys around the world, 24 articles on tours of the world's temples and churches, and interviews with more than 45 artists and entrepreneurs who share their remarkable achievements. The book also features interviews with more than 45 artists and entrepreneurs who share their remarkable achievements. And, of course, the most complete history of the world's rabbit culture and scientific mythology.
